lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I called you urgently because I had something to tell you. I'm sorry, can you wait a moment? There's something I wanted to do now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's going on?)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Did you call me, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I tried to pretend not to know, but I couldn't help it. As Gerda's representative, I will take one action.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: So, I’m going to ask for Peta’s understanding.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Yes? What is that... . I'm fine. Io, do whatever you feel comfortable with.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Then I will understand that you have given permission.
(Io raises his hand and slaps Peta's cheek.)

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: … Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Peta, please apologize to %s. And apologize to me and to all of Gerda's beings.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You knew about witches. And they probably recognized what someone like me knew about witches.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Even if my coming to Gerda wasn't accidental, I had to at least talk about it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It could have put us all in danger, not just your life... . Why didn't you say anything? Peta, I guess you're not such a stupid wizard.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: I was short-thinking. I was looking at the timing because I just wanted to meet Adventurer and tell him that... .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: The two of you disappeared right away, so I didn't have a chance to talk to them.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Is that really the case? It's a poor excuse for an accomplished wizard, but I'll believe it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Maybe you didn't have faith. At least we'll help you... . So I guess I just watched the situation.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Leave Gerda in a few days. No, to be exact, go back to Freios.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Dangerous days are coming soon to Eastland. Because your magical power may become the sacrifice for the bondage he desires.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Vice… .

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: Mr. Io. I'm sorry. I made a mistake.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Since you are sincere, I will forgive you. Thanks to this, we were able to adjust the timing to some extent.

lines.speaker: 페타
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: This is not a story for Peta to intervene in, so please step aside. Bye then.
(Peta looks at Io, who doesn't seem to want to deal with him anymore. After a while, he nods as if he understands and goes back.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Sorry, I waited a long time, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't feel like doing this, but sometimes it needs to be done. And, you'll have to watch Peta.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You don't necessarily have to do it yourself. Were you Miss Dana's subordinate? You take care of it well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know Dana?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I know roughly. Enough with this story, let me get to the point. Soon enough, Vice will summon Deimos.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Before that, Deborah tries to open the sealed road in the snowfield. Breaking the seal is never easy.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We must prevent the binding force from spreading into the snowy plains, and create a space to use as a temporary base.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Only then can we go to Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the meantime, I have work to do.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Since bondage changes the power of life, it requires magical power that can withstand that level, even if it is not the same.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How much?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: In Eastland, the representative group of wizards is the Jewel School. There are only a small number of Lumen left, so I wonder how long they can hold out even with all their might... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wouldn't something be possible if I received a trace of Medea's power?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't know how strong Miss Medea is... . First of all, I think it won't be enough. Iris is also worried.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, did you talk to Iris?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Did you forget? The reason I receive messages from the goddess is because I am somewhat more senior than %s.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The story is frozen. Let's break again and go.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Since the Sylvaria Empire is the land where the twilight of the gods was, there must be a way to delay the arrival of the gods.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: The Sylvaria Empire may already know this. Did they say that the emperor had the ability to foresee? .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: First, the Union of Light explained the situation and sent a letter to the Sylvaria Empire. There will be plenty of reasons to help there too.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: %s, I want you to go and find a way. First, go to Miss Medea. Maybe it will show you the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then I will go.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Okay, I'll wait... .
(As soon as Io comes, he looks at the back of %s leaving Gerda.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It won't be easy for %s, the goddess' errand boy... .

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What on earth was Agashura doing there anyway? I'm sure there was someone else... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I was waiting.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know what to say. Why are you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, go ahead. Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will tell you my position after my visit. and… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In this case, you will go there whether you like it or not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's there... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Knossos… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The ‘power’ stays there. I don't know if it's the power of a god, a witch, or Agashura, but... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think I can give Weiss a hard time with what I got there... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don’t know what kind of place it is, but I’ll go there.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He is a stronger person than anyone else.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I hope nothing happens.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me, Medea? Why do you talk like I'm never going to see you again?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Is that so? Because my speaking style is like this... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Heh… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Whether you like it or not, you'll have to keep coming to see me... .
(Mediah smiles lightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will visit often.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Huh, the barrier in our village doesn't work for you anyway... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go straight to Jis Card. It will tell you where to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. By the way, are you at Luman? You are away often... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It looks like you went to see your younger brother.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And… .
(Mediah gently taps %s on the shoulder with the staff she was holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You pat me on the shoulder like you did back then...)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: You must come back again… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, don't worry too much. Nothing will happen. I'll be back!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: See you later then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s in front of the lake… Is Jenna okay?)

steps.name: Finding the way (3)
steps.objective: After following [Iris], report the quest to [Soreille] in the “Magic Academy Lobby.”

lines.text: (A singing voice with a beautiful melody can be heard from a quiet lakeside in Jisk territory.)
(A clearer and more beautiful voice than before is flowing over the calm surface of the lake without losing its strength.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I will smile little by little♬ Because if I smile, it will become mine.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Still, I can't help but feel awkward♬

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I can't see the reflection in the pond... Well, that’s not all♪
(Jenna turns around in surprise at the sudden sound of applause.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: %s, are you here? Suddenly I heard applause and I thought a ghost had come.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Why are you doing this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it’s such a good song that I didn’t even realize it… . Are you surprised?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I was a little surprised, but it's okay. What brought you here? Are you here to meet your brother?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I heard that Jiscard would be there if I went here.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: What should I do with this? My brother passed away in a hurry just now, saying something happened while he was waiting. Instead, let me tell you something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, really? Then please tell me.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ahem, one, two, three… . Hey, you're here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Jenna, that’s imitating Jiscard… ?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Is it awkward? I prepared it in some way... . Then it won't work, right? Please keep listening.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My brother told me to go to Adventurer, saying he might know someone. A famous elf wizard in the Sylvaria Empire... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Soreyu?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: My brother said that we must strengthen our relationship with the Sylvaria Empire. I heard that the imperial emperor is quite friendly... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: And I heard you had some unexpected connections... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something involved….)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Who is that elf wizard?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He is a unique and interesting person. I also like delicious desserts.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: If I get a chance, I would like to meet you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll be able to meet someday.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: That could happen, right? This is all Gaia’s grace… . I am always grateful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Jenna’s expression seems to be better than before….)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I also want to help you and %s, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Just by existing, Jiscard is already of great strength.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Thank you. Dear %s,

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s go back to Freios….)
(The moment you are about to leave Jisk territory, someone grabs %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
%s… , just wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: … Iris?
(When I turned around at the word Iris, the Iris I saw in the oracle's room was smiling brightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Iris?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Jenna, it's been a while and I'm sorry for showing up like this. Is it okay if I take Adventurer with me?

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Okay, I'm done with the story.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go. There's something you want to tell me. But where are you going?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Just hold my hand and close your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, yeah.
(As soon as Iris finishes speaking, a mysterious light flows from Iris's fingertips and begins to surround the two people.)

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: He gave the gift of beautiful light to the lakeside.

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: I have to sing it too. I'll tell you when El comes... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Why isn't my son moving? It was moving well just a little while ago... .

lines.speaker: 제나
lines.text: Ah… . So, your brother left in a hurry... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Open your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, here… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Cluck cluck… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm fine. It would have been dangerous if we hadn't come here right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Jisk territory is being eroded little by little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could it be Vice?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I can't know for sure because my strength doesn't reach that level. However, an ominous force flows from Avalon.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Meanwhile, there were no signs from Avalon... . The power that filled the place was overflowing and I headed towards Jisk's territory.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Jiscard quickly moved to stop the force and asked me to help you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Io and Medea are sorry, saying they didn't know something like that would happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine, but Iris was dangerous.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. I can endure that much. Because it has to be that way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Jenna okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Jenna is fine. That power only affects life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is not the time to be like this. You have to hurry.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will continue to focus on preventing the ominous power flowing from Avalon from spreading to other places.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As I always say, I am always grateful and sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me too... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Are you going to meet Soreyu? I'll send you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Iris. Do you know anything about the witch who sent me a message?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: After ascending to godhood, all I learned was the recent events in this world. So there isn't much information about witches.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It seems that the witches have been in this world longer than anyone knows, and are waiting for the work of Deimos to end.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you waiting? If Deimos appears, it won't be good for the witches... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will tell you as soon as I find out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll find out too. What's more urgent now is stopping Deimos rather than the witch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go now.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Yes, give me your hand and close your eyes.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As I said last time, I will do everything for you as long as I can and as long as I have heart. And I will be there for those who cared for me.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So don't push yourself too hard. Did you know?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris.
(As soon as %s finishes speaking, Iris grabs his hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris’s hands are warm….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This warmth feels as if Iris trusts me….)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Are you out of your mind? %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, my head hurts… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Do you recognize me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it Soreyu?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, yes, it's me!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You've come to the right place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm dizzy... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Please lie here for a moment. I'll bring the nurse magic teacher.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: … Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thanks to you, my body feels lighter.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Thank goodness. I guess the shock was worse than I thought.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shock?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I was on my way to Glaston. Something fell from the sky and caused a car accident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Car accident… ?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: When I saw Fabrice biting and shaking it, I thought it was a human, so I told him to spit it out.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I looked and it was Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Am I falling from the sky? I just happened to collide with Soreyu, who was riding that monster?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were trying to eat me?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: It might be hard to believe, but it's true.
(Behind Soreyu, a three-headed monster, unknown whether it is a wolf or a dog, is growling and barking.)

lines.speaker: 페이브리스
lines.text: King Kuwawa!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I’m surprised!! It's Cerberus.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: No. This is Fabrice. I fed him and took him for a walk, so I wonder what I'm dissatisfied with... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll give you this. This is beef jerky for pets from Luman.

lines.speaker: 페이브리스
lines.text: Kuwawawa king!
(Fabris quickly runs up and grabs some beef jerky. He eats it deliciously, but sometimes gives Soreyu a cold look once or twice.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: … It's the first time I've seen that guy make an expression like that. I suddenly remember the time when I turned into that guy and I feel embarrassed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At that time, Soreyu was very fierce.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Now, Fabrice, be careful and go back. Ryosalp or Dockalp, whatever you want.

lines.speaker: 페이브리스
lines.text: Big, big!
(Fabris nods and flies powerfully into the sky. Then, he quickly enters the white clouds and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Then Adventurer. Let me help you... . Uh, what is this wind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .
(Someone's familiar voice is carried by the wind blowing from somewhere, approaching %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: (%s, I'm sorry. I said I'd take you to Soreyu, but... I didn't know Soreyu would be in the sky riding Fabless.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Iris, maybe. It's my first time so I'm just not used to it. are you okay… .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Iris appears to be here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, he didn't come directly, he sent me a message.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I see... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Now, let me tell you what I have prepared for you, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: His Majesty told me to gather information about Deimos before Jiscard makes a request.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … How was your Majesty able to prepare before the superhumans?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: … There is nothing I can say about that. Because I don't know... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Anyway, together with the librarians at the Belfar Library, we discovered an item that can delay the coming of Deimos.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: After the twilight years, when the gods were about to leave the world, some beings who wanted to stay tried to capture them.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: So I found what I needed. It was not the extinct gods, but the remnants of the dead gods, with only some images remaining.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: So they made something to catch those who left, but it is said that the gods' anger remained.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The power of the nameless gods who were swallowing their anger began to beat like a heart, and without hesitation it headed towards the Demon King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Beast….)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The Demon King was not affected by that power. Rather, he gave his power back to the gods who were trying to kill him.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The power that tried to catch those who left went to the remaining gods, swallowed their lives, and fell somewhere.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: So, it was decided that if the object had the power and lifespan of the god it swallowed, it could slightly delay the time when Deimos was about to descend.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where on earth do you find something like that?

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I'm looking at it as Knossos from Beast Man Empire Creed. It's a place beyond the western plains of El Anor.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Knossos….)

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: The beastmen believe that there are sacred objects there. It is said that during the time of Chaos Sky, that object caused an explosion and chased away the enemies... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: I don't know if that's true or not, but you need to check.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Soreyu. I'll go there. Somehow I feel like the answer I want is there... .

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: There will be Imperial partisans inside. Your Majesty has given permission to enter, so you can come in if you tell us. And I haven't done much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. It was helpful.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Then, after I go to Adventurer, I will find something to help with the wizards of Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Soreyu.

lines.speaker: 소레이유
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's go to Knossos... I'm sure the answer will be there.)
(A chilly wind is blowing through the road that passes the old trees in the western part of El Anor Plain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I only went a little further from the El Anor plains, but the atmosphere was very different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It feels ominous. That… .
(At the end of a seemingly unmaintained road, you can see a guard post and barricade that appear to belong to the Sylvarian Empire.)
(A person dressed as a guerrilla soldier sees %s coming here from afar and takes a alert posture.)

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: Stop! If you move, we will attack according to imperial law. Show something that can identify you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How about this?
(The guerrilla approaches, still alert, and snatches the paper bag from %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: I'll check in a moment. Apparently, this is what the imperial family uses when delivering letters... . The royal family's emblem... . Seeing that you even have the same title as His Majesty, you... .

lines.speaker: 유격병
lines.text: I made a mistake.
(The guerrilla’s mood changes smoothly in an instant.)

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Hello! I am Corporal Havarti of the Sylvaria Empire's guerrilla unit. I've always heard about Adventurer's activities, but I never thought I'd meet him like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not that great of a person.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Until you become humble... . He is truly a person who can serve as an example to everyone. I’m sorry to say this, but I’m a fan!!

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: I was a little nervous... Ahaha, I’ve heard you say this a lot… .
(The guerrilla's voice is slightly trembling.)

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: What's going on in Knossos? It would definitely be a big deal if a precious person came... .

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: There was already an item in the precautions when dispatching to help %s enter Knossos when he comes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Yes, that's right. We will do our best to help you. By the way.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Several months have passed since I was dispatched, but nothing special has happened in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Animals and beasts wander around, and fairies that you normally don't see can sometimes be seen.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: All I can say is that the guard who was there before I came went missing after going to ask Talos something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you missing?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Yes, Talos said he didn't see the guard.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But who is Talos?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Yes, I am the only administrator of Knossos. I'm not sure what the management style of the beast people is, but they say they've been taking care of Knossos for a long time, generation after generation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'd like to meet him sometime, but where is he?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: If you go inside Knossos, the prisoner will be wandering around leisurely.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Fortunately, compared to other beastmen, they are friendly to people from the empire and foreigners.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Havarti.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: No, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anything I can do to help you on your way to Talos?

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: No, such deep consideration... . Hmm, then what can I ask for? aha!

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: I hope you have a good time! I am satisfied with just that. I love you, Adventurer!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like a difficult comment to hear with a clear mind...)

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha, it's nothing.

lines.speaker: 하바티
lines.text: I'd like to give you guidance, but I'm sorry I'm at work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Then, I'll go in in a good mood. See you later, Havarti.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But here… As I was about to enter, the atmosphere changed. It was shaking.)

steps.name: Administrator of Knossos (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Hungry Lioncat] and [Life Hormoon] in “Knossos.” Then report to [Talos].

lines.text: (Unknown sculptures, waterfalls, and forests are all intertwined, creating a strange atmosphere. The unorganized path between them seems endless.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like the feeling of being shaken has disappeared. Is it because of my mood? Hmm… .
(After walking for a while, someone standing comes into view.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the person Guarantee Havarti was talking about?
(A man with hair that is whiter and longer than his eyes is looking this way. Despite his calm expression, his ears are very tense.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m not sure, but it feels like a wild beast stalking its prey… It has animal ears, but no tail. I don’t think it’s a beast… Also, it feels different from the Kali tribe…)
What, are you interested in me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. yes? yes?
I am Talos, Administrator of Knossos. Nice to meet you.
(A man who introduces himself as Talos extends his hand to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Your hands are bigger than you think.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What are you doing? You feel embarrassed about my hands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I am %s… no see.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: %s… ? Nice name. Where did you hear that? It's not a common name? %s, %s… . I just need to call you by name. We're not in the same group anyway... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Talos. There's something I'd like to ask... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: %s? %s! I'd like to repay you for the attention you gave me in a little while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Repayment?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: For now, let’s sort things out together with me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Aren’t you here because you want something from me? Then focus on what I need now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Just do what you always do. Now, over there.
(As soon as Talos finishes speaking, he runs to the direction he pointed to.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth is this person? Let’s just do what we always do….)

steps.name: Administrator of Knossos (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Nakun Rogue] and [Aquila Fighter] in “Knossos.” Then report to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Knossos isn't like this. It's like a quiet sleep.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: There aren't many beastmen left, and beings like spirits and fairies move around quietly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But everyone comes out aggressive, right?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Are you trying to scare me? What did I do wrong?
(Talos rubs his chin and makes a serious expression.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They are sensitive to external forces... . Ah, I think I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Some force you have or is directed at you is shaking this place.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: No matter how great the wizards and warriors came, this place was fine... . How tied are you to God?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute. The expression is a bit... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: For some, it may be a precious god, for others, it may be a mere existence.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Life in Knossos, including mine, is mostly the latter. However, there is only one god of mana.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: When you are really desperate, there are times when the existence of God does not appear. There are already records of ancient gods running away.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: At least that's what it says to me. Since he is a god that we cannot see or meet anyway, we can at least resent him. Isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That said… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: There is no time to stay like this. Those guys came rushing in. Because the residents of Knossos do not like receiving guests. Then let's drive it out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Talos… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If you have any questions, ask them later.

steps.name: things you need
steps.objective: Defeat [Pasiphae] in “Memory of the Heart” and obtain <Heart of Fury: Left Piece>. Then report to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Since we've kicked them out to a certain extent, it'll be quiet for a while. However, we will continue to react sensitively.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Well, since we have a lot of time, shall we get to the point?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't have much time.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Okay. Whether it's a question or a request, please tell me because I'll listen first and then judge.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of place is Knossos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It's a place that the people of the human empire don't have to worry about. The place where Creed's memories rest... Can I say that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Memories fall asleep?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: A long time ago, a war broke out here. While the Sylvaria Empire was gaining hegemony on the continent, the beastman must have been annoying.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: They invaded this place, saying they were trying to protect their country. At that time, there was talk that the beastman empire Creed was going to collapse, well… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Is it Genesis? Generis? It is said that he survived thanks to a wizard with that name.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Zerenis?)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: People in the empire don't know about this. History always belongs to the victors, and stories that disappear are boring stories.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Maybe that's why Knossos is a land that still remembers the times when the gods fled and when it was trampled by the Sylvaria Empire... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If there is a force you don't want, you naturally reject it. Strangely enough. The power you brought made this place what it is now.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: So, who are you?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What do you want from Knossos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You know me as an imperial person. I don't need to tell you everything, but...)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: He looks like he's worried about something. Just a moment ago, it seemed like he was trying to figure out something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need some stuff here.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Do we need something like a rolling relic? There are so many, so it doesn’t matter if you take at least one… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Are you some kind of superhuman?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: If the power is enough to shake Knossos, it would be the equivalent of a superhuman on another continent. A demigod of the church or something... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: At first glance, you seem like an unholy person who seems far removed from the holy demigod. It stinks too. haha.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As expected, I have a good eye for people. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, well... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I guess I'll just leave it at that. But the smell?)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: … If you need anything, go over there. I don't know what you're looking for, but go to [Memories of the Heart].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heart memory?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I don't want to get involved with the Sylvaria Empire, so I'll quickly do my business and go back. I hope you can find what you're looking for quickly. If you have anything to ask in the middle, you can come.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll be around here. It's already time to pull out the grass. Ah, the heart's memory must be inside there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Talos. Let’s go to the memories of the heart.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What do you do with something like that? I am only informing you as the manager of Knossos. Now the only… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'm not good at lying, the goddess's Adventurer... . I don't know if you can go and survive.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The Grand Duke and the Prince themselves woke them up from their sleep... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Oh, it's really annoying. I heard a jingling noise, so I guess the Grand Duke came here on an outing.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Imperial knights come and go, spirits who speak dialect come and go, and mercenary kids come and go. It looks like a stage laid out according to the Archduke's wishes.
(With Talos's sarcasm, a black butterfly flies from somewhere and creates a human shape.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The sound of coins is so annoying.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's been a while, Talos. no… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Don't call me that name. Don't be annoyingly formal.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This is a natural behavior for any intelligent and thinking being.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: That's funny. So what is the purpose?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: What is your purpose?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hahahaha!! Interesting. me? I have a favor to ask you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Are you going to play a trick even if you know it?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The Grand Duke, please answer that question. The reason it came back.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: First of all, I don't know what the coming night will be like, but there are things I am preparing in my own way.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: What? Let’s see, let’s see… .
(Talos frowns and grabs Barbatos by the collar.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Anyway, you and I have different paths to take. It's not like you killed someone for God... .
(As Barbatos grins, the black butterflies hovering around him suddenly multiply. Talos, startled, hurries back.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Damn butterfly... . Something of a certain goddess comes to mind. That feels worse, but... .
(The black light dragged by the black butterfly suddenly envelopes Barbatos and soon disappears.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Yes, Archduke… . Let's see who will laugh first.
(In a forest filled with a humid smell, a large structure connected to machines and wires can be seen in the distance.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that?
(Plus, an unidentifiable sound comes from somewhere and bothers my ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Plus this sound... . This feeling... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It’s not unfamiliar… but I definitely know. The sound of a machine coming from somewhere….)
rattle.
rattle. rattle.
(Following this, a clear sound of bells rings out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this a bell sound? It's like it's up to something... .
rattle. rattle. rattle.
(The sound of the bells seemed to be getting closer, but suddenly stopped.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because of my mood?
No.
(Someone pokes %s in the cheek from behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
What is it, honey, it's me, it's me. To Pasiphae.
(A girl calling herself Pasiphae opens her arms and tries to hug her. But she notices something and backs away.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Hehe, it's not us honey. Some octopus has arrived.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, that’s not a octopus… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Cat ears? Then I don’t think they are beastmen… Kali tribe? No, something is different… they have tails.)
rattle.
(As Pasiphae moves, the sound of the bell on her neck can be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, does this bell belong to that person? But that girl appeared from behind so that I couldn’t even tell she was there. What the hell….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I'm in Pasiphae. One of the great administrators of Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It was said that there was only one manager of Knossos...)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But man, who are you? Are you the one sent by Zerenis?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zelenis? Archmage Zerenis?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Yes, Zelenis. I thought he came looking for me again. Come see us later honey.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But how do I get out of here? Isn't it strange that you can't leave the place you come in every day?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I think it's been that way since he gave it to us... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: How did you get into this place? Obviously the administrator's permission... .
(For a moment, Pasiphae's eyes, who were licking her hand, change. And a dagger appears from the tip of her finger at high speed and heads towards %s's neck.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Hey, you dodged my attack.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I almost got into big trouble...)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: That's not the end... , huh? What is this? Black butterfly... .
(Suddenly, black butterflies that flew out of nowhere began to surround Pasiphae.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This butterfly belongs to Barbatos... .
(The butterfly, which has turned into deep darkness, swallows Pasiphae and scatters away.)
rattle.
rattle. rattle.
rattle. rattle. rattle.
(The sound of Pasiphae's bell ringing once in a while fluctuates and gradually becomes quieter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, I have to follow that sound... .
rattle.
(While wandering around in my heart's memory for a while, I can faintly hear the sound of Pasiphae's bell coming from one side.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's definitely nearby... .
(As we walk a little further, we see afterimages of black butterflies scattering the darkness. Then, the figures of Barbatos and Pasiphae slowly come into view in the darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think we're talking, let's wait and see.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Did you say Barbatos? The name is difficult.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: So, Archduke, if you are saying that the men we sent betrayed us?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Our empire was handed over to Sylvaria... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Zerenis promised a future for Freios with us. A continent where beasts and humans coexist... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The great wizard Zerenis was killed and could not be with us. And you, the great king and warrior of the beast people, were put to sleep by your subordinates.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Is Zelenis dead?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: That's a shame.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's funny how someone who doesn't believe in God could use the power of God to stop time in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And that’s for hundreds of years… . It's happened on other continents too. The timing is similar... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute, I heard this somewhere….)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Still, I, who will be a god, have specially awakened you. However, we couldn't send you out of each area.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Your guys were pretty meticulous. I tried to wake you up once before, but you were in a deep sleep.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Isn't it really awful to play pranks?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: … Can I trust you?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: That butterfly headdress on your head. A long time ago, I gave it to the Beast King as a token of friendship.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You said there was a woman you cared about.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Oh my, honey? So should I believe it? Grand Duke, then what should I do?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How about talking to Adventurer of the goddess who is eavesdropping on us over there?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As I said before, %s you don't have a choice.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Hey Grand Duke… .
(Pasiphae grins and holds two daggers in her hands. Then, she moves at high speed and appears behind Barbatos.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: How dare demons tell the best beast warrior to do this or that? If you're going to give up your head so easily... .
(Barvatos gently pushes away the dagger that is near his throat with the tip of his finger.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I am truly sorry. You made me say regret again... . Miss Pasiphae, you are truly foolish. I'm here to help... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: He is a beast who believed in a foolish god and could become one with humans, so he makes this choice.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Ugh… Ugh… . My arms move as they please... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I could cut you down here, but you are no match for me. So, you are next to the foolish Beast King.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I'll kill you. But my body does whatever it wants... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You should compete against someone you are compatible with. I would like the Adventurer of the goddess you see over there.
(With Barbatos' words, Pasiphae slowly walks in front of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos, even though you made Michaela like that back then... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Mika? Did you fight alongside the gods in the old days?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Goddess Adventurer saved the battle angel from me, so I hope that she will also save the ancient warrior of the beast people.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A witch preparing for a new night, Lux, the foolish demon lord, and the god of fear brought by a sinner... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The old man has prepared so many disgusting things. To destroy this world... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Really annoying things... .
(Barvatos' expression distorts as he adjusts his glasses. However, he soon returns to his calm self.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Whoa, I was rude. I have a lot of work to do, so I'll just leave. I'm talking about all sorts of things.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And Miss Pasiphae, there is nothing false in what I said. I, Adventurer, will prove the truth of what I say, so fight until you die.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I look forward to seeing what the awakened Beast King will look like now. If he is angry, Freios will definitely... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: He shouldn't be angry... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now, Miss Pasiphae. May you cut down the god you cherish and the Adventurer chosen by that god.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: As a god-killer, life in Deerside wouldn't be bad... .
(Pasiphae's eyes change with Barbatos' hand gesture.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a similar situation to Michaela... . I don't know if it's possible, but I'll have to try it on my own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Iris….)
(After an arduous battle, %s's final blow passes by Pasiphae with all his might.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It was a difficult opponent. So please make sure this attack is the last. It's hard to resist...)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Thank you… .
(Pasiphae's legs seem to have lost strength, and she falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I'm fine. Thanks to you, it's back to normal... . I spent a lot of energy because of the demon called Archduke.
(Pasiphae withdraws her weapon and looks intently at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Ah, I feel like I’ve seen this before… . Oh, this isn't it.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: This ribbon was something we gave it to ourselves, but it had the power of the demon called Archduke attached to it. It's gone now... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: But it's strange. There is no reason for me to be controlled by the power of demons... . What is that archduke?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a long story... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: You can talk briefly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: You don't trust me. If you tell me, I will cooperate as much as I can. You said it was the Adventurer of the goddess, right? You didn't just come here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Pasiphae briefly about the new goddess Iris, the identity of Barbatos, and how she came to Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: There was a successor to Goddess Ceres. I didn't even know how many gods there were left... . And the Grand Duke wants to become the god of this world... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: It's complicated, but I get it.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I've never seen Deimos the Twisted One, but I know how dangerous it can be when it appears. It may not be as good as the Demon Beast, but... .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: There was a time when I felt fear approaching Freios.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So I'm here looking for a way to stop Deimos.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Here? There's nothing like that here... . Oh, this health?
(Pasiphae takes something out of her arms and shows it to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heart shaped stone? It's broken.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: It is a heart of anger that can be said to be a sign of love with ourselves. The other half is for us.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, I'm surprised. What is this? It's beating like a real heart!

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: That's right, heart. It is also the heart of the golem that we cherish.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: There are a lot of golems here that we made for the gods in the twilight years. He must have been charging with his heart... . Huh?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: No… ? There isn't one!! Our golem slumbers in the heart of Knossos... . doesn't exist!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Golem?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Yeah. Golem. Seeing that the golem isn't there, Creed must have been completely betrayed... . I can't do it. We need to tell ourselves quickly. Let's go together. Let me help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's go out together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pasiphae, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I can't get out of here... . Some force unfolding here is blocking me. Is this also the work of the archduke or the demon?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: I can't help it. You go meet us instead of me. If I'm like this, we probably won't be able to get out of there either.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Honey, what are we doing now? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. I will go and see you.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Then I will leave my heart of anger to you.
(Pasiphae takes out a heart-shaped stone from her bosom and places it in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is the heart of anger... I feel a strong vibration. It feels like I'm getting angry.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: The Heart of Wrath is a part of this world entrusted to us by God. Things from the twilight years… .  For now, we have the other half. If we unite, it will help stop the twisted one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Pasiphae. So where should I go to meet him?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: [Acro’s Pavilion]… . You'll find it soon. I have to make sure I can come out later too. Okay?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Don't worry about me. This is my land, so it'll be okay. As it happens, your goddess, the new goddess, said it was okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it Iris?

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Yeah, so go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will... . sorry. I will definitely find a way and come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to go to Talos first.)

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: Aineng is as delicate as Zerenis. Let's be friends next time.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: However, the Archduke clearly said that someone who does not believe in God brought the power of God and stopped time in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 파시파에
lines.text: (…Talos, Daedalus. Who is it between the two? The one who did this….)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Have you seen everything?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I haven't found anything yet. By the way, Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A demon appeared inside me. Do you know anything?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Demon? Why are there demons in Knossos? . I have no idea... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Do you really not know? Are you just pretending not to know? But it's not interfering with work, so don't worry too much about it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really? Hmm. Then I have no choice but to go to [Acro's Pavilion].

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: By the way, what did the demon say?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What will he look like when he gets angry? , he said.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (In an instant, Talos’ expression changed.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I don't know who is angry, but there is no one like him in this forgotten land. As a manager, I have nothing to be angry about. But the demons… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I will go to the [Acro's Pavilion] you mentioned.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll just wander around as I please, so if anything happens, come find me.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ah, [Acro's Coffin] will be a little more complicated than [Memories of the Heart].

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing will happen. Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, let’s go to Acro’s coffin.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have a feeling something is going to happen... uh, Iris?)

lines.speaker: 이리스의 목소리
lines.text: (%s…. The situation in Knossos is a little strange. I will send you to a safe place for a while.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh? Uh... .
(Talos watches %s from afar and laughs lightly when he suddenly disappears.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It's fascinating. Did God call you?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It doesn't concern me now, so I guess I'll just wait... .

steps.name: Beast King Minos
steps.objective: Defeat [Minos] in “Acro's Coffin” and obtain <Heart of Fury: Right Piece>. Then report to [Talos] in 「Knossos」.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I was surprised that he suddenly appeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was also surprised to see Medea appear in front of me. Anyway, I'm glad. It didn't fall from the sky this time!

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Ah, I guess Iris isn't familiar with it. By the way, you brought something. Could you show it to me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He shows Medea the half heart of anger and tells her what happened in Knossos and [Memories of the Heart].)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: During the time when there was war in Prayos, the Heart of Wrath was a mysterious object that exploded and drove away enemies when they entered Knossos... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's only half-hearted, but I feel something. This anger… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And as expected, the administrators Talos and Pasiphae you mentioned were not much different from the Kali tribe.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Moreover, receiving a message from the goddess... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's complicated.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There's a lot to unpack, but it's not that complicated. %s… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Since the Beast King has the other half, he will need me to turn it into one.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Iris… .
(Medea looks at the sky and calls out Iris's name. Then, after a while, Iris slowly appears next to %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know it's hard for you, but I also want you to send me to Knossos.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm fine. So are you ready?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I have made up my mind whether to go to Knossos or for Eastland. So, I am going to find something to do in Knossos.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, Medea. Then I will hurry. And %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Iris. But what does it mean that the flow of Knossos is likely to become strange?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not sure, but it seems like someone doesn't like the presence of God's power. So, I sent it here.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I think Knossos is okay now. So, I will let you go again with Medea.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll make sure it falls off well this time. So don't worry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, you’re saying it makes it fall off easily?
(It was already much too late when I realized that Iris was looking sorry.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I heard a thud and something falling, so I looked and it was you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouch… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: But there you… . I think I'm with this guy. Is he a man of God?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Half right, half wrong.
(Talos looks at Medea.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Huh, as expected, he’s different from that person. Those clothes, that cane... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Please refrain from comparing yourself to someone you know.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As a living being, it is inevitable to compare yourself with other beings you know. By the way, is this your first time in Knossos?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It's my first time, but I don't want to stay long.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: … Are you denying this place?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Haha… . I know you don't like God. So it must have been related to him.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It just makes sense. It doesn't mean anything.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He also said that when he did something. But, you know the result.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Do what you need, just do what you need to do and then go back. otherwise… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. I won't mince words after saying this.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It's not normal either.
(Mediah places her staff on the shoulder of %s, who is still unconscious.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It seems like the goddess still has a hard time controlling long distances. Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, thanks to you, it got better... But, I think you talked to Talos... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll tell you when I see the Beast King. Now, let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, but… . Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. Let's go first.
(Talos stares at the backs of Mediah and %s as they head towards [Acro's Pavilion].)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: As expected, it's fair to say that she has a corner to fight. But, it will take a different path. Since I confirmed it, I guess I’ll play a prank too… .
(Talos raises his staff and points to the sun in the sky.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Anyway, I feel sorry for the Beast King too. I fell asleep for a long time and then woke up... .
(When the tip of the staff strikes the ground, an unknown energy flows out. And it brings out a certain resonance that could not be felt in Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The sky is crying, the earth is angry... . Ah, %s, you better watch your way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was a bit surprised because the ground suddenly shook.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Perhaps it was caused by someone who didn't like our presence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We… Did you say that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, we… . Is there any problem?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No… . I was a bit surprised.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Don't worry about the little things, and focus on meeting the Beast King at Acro's Pavilion.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: By the way, it seems like there's more buried here than I thought... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I need to know what the liar is hiding, but he won't tell me easily... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you're a liar... . uh?
No… . no!! This can’t be happening!! Wow!!
Ugh… . Why is this land that Minos has protected like this... .
(Someone's angry scream is heard and the ground continues to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Minos?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: That voice seems to be the Beast King. Minos must be his name.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Anyway, the Beast King realizes something and can't hold back his anger... . I think the energy of the ground also contributed to my anger... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: We don't know what's causing him trouble, but this meeting will definitely not be easy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … We might have to fight.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: However, you don't need to worry too much.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, you said you wandered through the heart's memories, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think it's the same here. There is a little device... . I'll try to solve it to some extent... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, you go ahead first. Then at least you won't be lost for a long time.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: First of all, if you meet the Beast King and have a long conversation, I will come to you shortly.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think we need to stop him quickly… . If his power harnesses the Heart of Wrath, it will never end in Knossos... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll hurry. So be careful.
(%s leaves first, followed by the Beast King's anger again.)

lines.speaker: 미노스의 목소리
lines.text: Wow!! Once you come here, you will never return alive... .
(The Beast King's anger and screams are filling Knossos.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I feel pain... . This is... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I won't let your anger grow, so please be patient... .
(While heading to the center of Acro's coffin, all entities in the way fall or retreat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew, we finally made it this far... . Luckily, I didn't get too lost. Is this all because of Medea’s efforts?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now I just have to go over the hill in front of me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh, the ringing stopped?
(The screams of Minos that had overthrown Knossos a moment ago can no longer be heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Something is strange... . Why did it suddenly stop?

lines.speaker: 미노스의 목소리
lines.text: Why do you have a piece of my heart?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?!
(When the voice that filled Knossos suddenly appears as if rising from the ground, Adventurer is startled and falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm surprised... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It's very unpleasant to be surprised by my appearance. I have mercy on you, grab this and get up.
(Minos holds out his staff in front of the fallen %s.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I am Minos, Lord of Creed. And this is my castle, Acropolis… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I won't say it again. wake up

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now, let’s hold on and get up….)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Now, tell me. Who are you and why do you have the piece that Pasiphae had?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: And the reason I came here... . I want to know everything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Surprisingly, conversation might work.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I am %s… no see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He gives a brief introduction to Minos, explains why he came here, and even tells the story of what happened to Pasiphae.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I see. I understood it to some extent.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: So you need a heart of anger?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, with that artifact you can fight off the villains who are trying to summon Deimos.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Yeah?
(Minos quietly takes out a piece of stone that appears to be the Heart of Anger from his chest.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: You don't know what the heart of anger means.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minos?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Did you think I would just give this to you?
(Minos puts the Heart of Wrath piece back into his bosom and waves his staff. Then, the force that explodes around him blows Adventurer far away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… . why… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I can't trust you.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: First of all, I don't know if what you say is true or false.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trust… I’m saying the same thing as Medea.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: If you want to be trusted, take my test and prove yourself. That you are a new man of God.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It won't be easy. Something that defeats me... .
(Minos raises his staff once again and looks at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can’t help it, it won’t be easy…. Iris, protect me….)
(An attack strong enough to shake Knossos continues without stopping.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I don’t think I can finish it. I have to finish it in one go.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Let me stop for a moment.
(Minos must have read %s's expression and puts his staff back inside. Then, he throws something at %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... ?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I will give it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heart of Anger... . Do you trust me?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I saw faith in your attacks. I can't say that's the trust I want, but... . First of all, it would be nice if you could talk to me for a little bit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Because it's great for dealing with my anger. So, attack with all your might... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So let's fight more? If we continue to fight like this, Knossos will become dangerous... . Minos-sama’s power seems somewhat dangerous… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s is correct.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Are you… . Is your name Medea?
(Media nods at Minos' call. Minos looks curiously at Medea, who comes in front of him as Minos does.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Your anger won't stop, and you know that you can't meet the memories your heart holds like this... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: … I know.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: So you need to get rid of your anger.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: What if you don't do that?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: If you want to see you and your beloved Knossos disappear from the map of Phraeos, then so be it.
(Minos looks dumbfounded at Mediah’s words. Then he starts laughing like crazy.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Hahaha, hahahaha... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Beast King. thank you I will definitely find a way for you two to get out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Does that mean… Pasiphae and Minos can’t go out?)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I can trust you, right?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes. I promise. If you can't trust me, the power I have... .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: I don't need your strength. Instead, make me one promise. That human.
(Minos raises his finger and points to Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Me?

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Let that person come to me from time to time. That way, I will do what I can, whether for this world, for you, or for God.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Thank you. Minos. And, %s… . Come closer to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes.
(Medea shows %s the pieces of the Heart of Fury in her hands. As she grasps them, the pieces shatter.)

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Are the memories of Knossos together? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea? Why is my heart so angry... . This is... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: This is a trace of my power... .
(Medea creates a sphere of power mixed with the Heart of Fury from her fingertips and places it in the hands of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hold it in your chest.
(As soon as %s's hand touches his chest, the sphere just seeps inside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this feeling... .  Finally, all superhuman powers... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: In this way, Iris can see everything about Eastland. And you might recall some of Freios' memories.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … That means… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Deimos will also appear slightly later due to the influence of Iris. And ask Iris for the rest.
(Medea laughs and pushes %s's back.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now go to Talos, who is said to be the manager of Knossos. I have something to say to the Beast King... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea, let’s go together.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: It will take a long time. So go first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, then Minos. I'll come back later.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: It was called Medea, but your name was Medea. Daphne's chosen child... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I am neither Medea nor her child. He is just a person who leads the Kali tribe.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: The name of that village on another continent is ‘Kali’.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Together with Iris, we will help Minos and Pasiphae get out of here someday.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: Even if you don't do it, someone else will come someday. Wait until then.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know who will come, but I will do it that way.

lines.speaker: 미노스
lines.text: By the way, you probably knew that your choice for God could be poisonous to you. The traces of that power have gone to God, so you are now... .
(Medea smiles as if nothing has happened.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'm fine. I was just showing the goddess the amount of trust I have in her.
(Talos' face distorts as he sees %s.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: From the looks of it, the purpose of visiting Knossos must have been achieved... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I told him to go to Talos.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I have nothing to say. Go back. Wait, you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: In the meantime, I felt like something had changed... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The anger that hung over Knossos has disappeared.  talk to me

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Talos what happened in Acro's coffin.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Ahaha, hahahaha, hahahahaha.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you smiling like that?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: No, this situation is too funny... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You had a hard time putting Knossos to sleep, but then the damn Archduke came and woke you up?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I didn't like you trying to find out the secrets of Knossos, so you provoked the Beast King, but you managed to survive?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Hehe, I thought nothing much would happen as long as I was controlling Knossos, but that's not the case... . Ahahaha!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos, were you one of Minos?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: It was like that in the past.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I know you're interested in me, but how about we call it a day?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Thanks to you, I have more work to do. I noticed something about the Sylvaria Empire and the Demon World... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: You will know anyway, even if you don’t want to know. So, stay alive.

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I only felt sorry for the dead guard warden.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why did the guard die?

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Do you want to find out more from me? This kid is really interested in me.
(Talos grins.)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: I'll tell you that. Guard Warden Disel learned of a secret hidden here. He came to me to check it out... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Before that, he met someone else and died... . He was a good friend. To be exact, that being may have come to visit the guard... .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: The guard buried him in a sunny place. Don't worry, there's a tomb somewhere over there. This is all I know. I don’t know who that being is, so find out for yourself… .

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: Oh, if you want to find out more from me, come by often. You'll have to build trust.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trust….)

lines.speaker: 탈로스
lines.text: There are quite a few people here who need company. How you build trust is your choice. Hehe… .
(After the conversation is somewhat over, Talos turns his back and disappears somewhere in the streets of Knossos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talos?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It's gone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened here? Even if I achieve my goal, something feels uncomfortable... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So where do we go now... huh?)
(Someone gently taps %s on the shoulder.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Medea? Are you here?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I guess you're done talking with Talos. Then let's go to Cali.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right from here to Cali?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Any stone that holds the memory of Knossos will send us there. To the village of our Kali people... .

(Medea picks up a stone with a certain pattern on it from the ground and places it on her hand. Then the stone containing the memory of Knossos spreads like powder and takes the two people somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No way, I thought, but you really came.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Hey, Medea? What that means is that you may not have been able to come to Kali.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Hehe, don't be too scared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, did you have a good conversation with the Beast King?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: While talking with Minos, an unknown faith arose in Knossos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who on earth is Talos?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now I can tell you. If we tell his story there, we might not be able to come out... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? What is that... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Now Knossos can be said to be the person himself... .  anyhow… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He is the one who killed the followers of God. And he hopes that beings like him will be higher than the humans God loves.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: He said a long time ago.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: There was an older brother who killed his younger brother who followed God, became the manager of a certain land, and swallowed up that land... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: The older brother's name is 'Daedalus'... . This is Talos now... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know what he's up to, but I think he made a deal.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Maybe that deal led some people from Knossos to come to Cali... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I don't know exactly. but… . This is my job %s you don't have to know about. So, continue to focus on things that stand in your way, Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: And I think I'll have to go to Deborah soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Soon... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I think Iris will let you know when the time comes. %s, your work will not end when Avalon's work ends.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because there are still many enemies.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I'll be happy to help, so please come back often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: No. Then, rest in Cali today. I'll talk to Beynon... . Have a meal too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. I will. Thank you, Medea.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Go to Merrymel. He will tell you where to rest.
(As %s heads towards where Merrymel is, Medea, who is left alone, quietly looks up at the sky.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: My choice was not wrong. Because I won't regret it. And I will definitely put a stop to that person’s antics.
